annotations.title: Compare one rule across many places

description: One rule across every municipality of a comunidad or provincia (or a list of place_ids), in one call: its value in each, with source, check date and tier. Suited to portfolio and "where can I…" questions, e.g. key alquiler_turistico_licencias over a province (where new tourist rentals are allowed) or ibi_urbana_tipo (property tax by town). Paginated by 150. En español: comparar una norma o impuesto entre municipios (dónde se permite el alquiler turístico, qué municipio tiene el IBI más bajo).

area_id.description: A comunidad or provincia place id from find_place.

key.description: A rule key, e.g. alquiler_turistico_licencias, ibi_urbana_tipo, plusvalia_tipo_gravamen, itp_tipo_general.

offset.description: Pagination offset (next_offset of the previous page).

place_ids.description: Instead of area_id: up to 200 place ids.

name: compare_rule
